card.name: Ocean law and maritime texts
card.fires_on: Scattered words in passages about the sea, ocean law, ships and nautical distance, such as the digit 1 in years like 1982 and small words like of, to, over. It is not tied to one word.

modes.label: Digit in years
modes.description: The digit 1 starting a year or count in ocean-treaty or naval history text.

modes.label: Small words in sea-law phrases
modes.description: Linking words or punctuation inside sentences about shore distance, rights over marine resources or ship duties.
modes.example: special rights<< over>> the use of marine resources

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning surrounding or nearby, and away from island words.
card.plain: It lights up on ordinary words in texts about oceans, maritime law and ships, with no single trigger word.
